set_horizontal_swing_mode.name: Set the horizontal swing mode
set_horizontal_swing_mode.description: Set the horizontal swing mode for climate device.

set_weekly_timer_day.name: Set weekly timer day
set_weekly_timer_day.description: Replace the patterns of one or more days of an air conditioner's weekly timer. Saving also turns the weekly timer on unless enabled is false, like the Comfort Cloud app does.

patterns.name: Patterns
patterns.description: Up to 6 patterns, each with start_time (HH:MM) and optionally power (on/off), mode (auto/dry/cool/heat/fan), temperature and fan_speed (auto/low/low_mid/mid/high_mid/high). An empty list clears the days. Uses the same shape as the schedule attribute of the weekly timer switch.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether the weekly timer should be on after saving.

set_aquarea_weekly_timer_day.name: Set Aquarea weekly timer day
set_aquarea_weekly_timer_day.description: Replace the patterns of one or more days of an Aquarea heat pump's weekly timer. Saving also turns the weekly timer on unless enabled is false, like the Comfort Cloud app does.

patterns.name: Patterns
patterns.description: Up to 6 patterns, each with start_time (HH:MM) and optionally mode (heat/cool/auto), zone1/zone2 (on/off) with zone1_heat/zone1_cool/zone2_heat/zone2_cool setpoints, and tank (on/off) with tank_temperature. Leave out zones or the tank the unit doesn't have. An empty list clears the days. Uses the same shape as the schedule attribute of the weekly timer switch.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether the weekly timer should be on after saving.

set_hws_weekly_schedule.name: Set hot water weekly schedule
set_hws_weekly_schedule.description: Replace the weekly schedule of a standalone hot water heat pump.

weekly_schedule.name: Weekly schedule
weekly_schedule.description: List of days in the same shape as the weekly_schedule attribute of the water heater. Each day needs a weekday and a mode.
